sourceChecks.sourceText: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
sourceChecks.previousContext: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

authorRepairs.reasonJa: 固定WEB 1CH 2:42はMeshaをCalebの長子とし、Ziphの父と記す。Caleb自身はJerahmeelの兄弟であり、MeshaをCalebの兄弟の子とした旧訳は係り受けを逆にしていたため修正。
